lines.differs: Explicitly includes Subcontractor activity and electronic PHI, whereas the SIGNED version only covers Business Associate activity.
Defines PHI and HIPAA specifically, whereas the SIGNED version applies general upstream BAA obligations to the subcontractor.
Defines PHI per HIPAA regulations rather than broader state data privacy laws or GLBA compliance.
Adds specific coverage for Texas Privacy Law and regulatory fines; removes mutual indemnification and gross negligence requirements.
One-way indemnification by Business Associate specifically for HIPAA and Texas Privacy Law violations, replacing mutual general liability.
Adds specific indemnification for HIPAA violations and regulatory fines, and removes the third-party claim requirement for recovery.
Asserts Covered Entity ownership of PHI and prohibits AI training usage, rather than granting contractor ownership of work.
Expressly prohibits using PHI for AI training and excludes PHI from any contractor ownership or interest.
Specifically identifies PHI as sole property of Covered Entity and prohibits machine learning usage.
